## 27.1 Measuring performance

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A frame at 60 fps takes about 16.7 ms.
- The 1 % low shows the slowest frames.
- Stutters hide in the average frame rate.
- **Do it:** Compute the frame time of 120 fps. How many milliseconds is it?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/frame-times.png)
:::
::::

## Example · It jerks every few seconds

The fps counter of Pocket Quest shows 57 fps on average.
**Why do players still complain?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The frame-time graph shows **four frames of about 50 ms**.
2. The 1 % low is only about **20 fps**.
3. The game loaded a track piece in those frames, so the team loads it **earlier**.
:::

## 27.2 Heat, throttling and a cap

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A long, heavy load makes the chip hot.
- A hot chip slows down, so the frame rate falls.
- A frame-rate cap keeps the race steady and cooler.
- **Do it:** Play 20 minutes on the P5 with and without a cap. Which feels better?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/thermal.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Performance

a) What is the frame time at 30 fps?
b) What happens to a hot chip in a long race?
c) Which two settings keep the race steady on a weak phone?

::: {.answer}
a) about 33.3 ms
b) It throttles and slows down.
c) a frame-rate cap and lower graphics settings
:::

## 27.3 Compatibility

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A build for Android 11 does not start on Android 8.
- A GPU without Vulkan needs another graphics API.
- Menus need anchors for every screen shape.
- **Do it:** Make every row green in Compatibility Lab. What does it cost?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/compat-matrix.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/compat-lab.html" poster="sims/compat-lab.png" title="Compatibility Lab: build 43 for every device" task="**Show:** fix the minimum Android, add OpenGL ES 3, anchor the menu. **Ask:** is it always worth supporting the oldest phones?" >}}

## Example · Build 43

Build 42 failed on three test devices.
**What changes in build 43?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The minimum is now **Android 8**, so the old AVD starts the game.
2. **OpenGL ES 3** next to Vulkan gives the old phone a picture.
3. A menu anchored to the **safe area** fits the tablet and the notch phone.
:::

## 27.4 Reliable sources

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Release notes list the changes of a new OS version.
- Official documents and our own tests are reliable.
- Forum claims and ads are only claims to check.
- **Do it:** Find two changes in the newest release notes. What is their date?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/sources.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Reports (harder)

a) Which number shows the jerks of a 58 fps race?
b) What is a likely cause of a black screen on an old phone?
c) What does Rami do with a forum claim about an OS update?

::: {.answer}
a) the 1 % low
b) The GPU does not support the graphics API.
c) Read the release notes and test it.
:::

## Summary

- We measure frame times and the 1 % low.
- Heat makes phones throttle, and a cap keeps the race steady.
- Builds fail by OS version, graphics API or screen shape.
- A compatibility matrix records every device.
- Reliable sources and our own tests follow the platform changes.
